summary: Website project: add an Articles/Blog publishing section so posts can be published and viewed; user also wants email notifications when someone posts an article (may be blocked by plan limitations).
architectural_notes: Email notification capability may depend on plan/upgrade; treat as blocked until email features are available.
known_issues: Currently no article-publishing feature exists, so shared/published articles do not appear on the site.

existing_features.title: Add an Articles/Blog section in the frontend so visitors can browse published articles and open a full article detail page, using the existing published story feed and detail functionality.

Implement a "My Submissions" page for authenticated users to see articles they have submitted and whether each is Pending (not yet published) or Published, so submitters can verify their content was received even before moderation/publishing.

Update the submission confirmation UI to clearly explain that submitted articles are not publicly visible until published, and provide a direct link to "My Submissions" (for logged-in users) so the user can immediately confirm the submission is recorded.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add an Articles/Blog section with article publishing so shared posts are visible on the site
Send email notifications to authorsanakhan@gmail.com when someone posts an article

projectName: Add Articles/Blog publishing flow so submitted posts can be published and visible
